name: Bicycle
scene: A bicycle standing upright side-on on the floor (wheels in the XY plane, front wheel toward +x, drive side facing the viewer at +z): diamond frame from tubes (hoses), fork, handlebar with brake levers, saddle on a seat post, two wheels with tyres, rims, hubs and spokes, chainring, crank arms and pedals, rear cassette, chain loop, rear derailleur, brakes (rim calipers or disc).
size: Wheels 0.66-0.74 m diameter (axles at 0.34-0.37 m), wheelbase 1.0-1.1 m, saddle at 0.9-1.0 m, handlebar about 1.0 m.

parts.label: Front wheel
parts.describe: Group at the front axle with tyre (torus, rubber), rim (torus, aluminium), spokes (thin cylinders with repeat spin about the axle - give the wheel group rotation [90,0,0] so its y is the axle), hub; spins about the axle.

parts.label: Rear wheel
parts.describe: Like the front wheel, with the cassette of cogs on the drive side.

parts.label: Tyre valve
parts.describe: Valve stem with a small cap on the rim, child of the rear (or front) wheel; the cap unscrews.

parts.label: Chain
parts.describe: Closed loop (hose with chain material, first point repeated at the end) around the chainring and the rear cogs.

parts.label: Chain grime
parts.describe: Black oily grime on the chain (oil or grime patch along it).

parts.label: Crank and pedals
parts.describe: Chainring with crank arms and pedals at the bottom bracket; turns backwards to run the chain.

parts.label: Rear derailleur
parts.describe: Hanging cage with two small pulleys below the rear cogs.

parts.label: Front brake
parts.describe: Rim caliper above the front tyre (or a disc caliper by the hub) with two pads; squeezes in when the lever is pulled.

parts.label: Rear brake
parts.describe: Caliper on the seat stays above the rear tyre.

parts.label: Brake lever
parts.describe: Lever on the handlebar, pivots toward the grip.

parts.label: Quick release
parts.describe: Lever on the front hub that flips open to free the wheel.

parts.label: Seat clamp
parts.describe: Clamp lever where the seat post enters the frame.

parts.label: Saddle
parts.describe: Seat on the seat post; slides up when the clamp is open.

debris: a thorn or glass in the tyre (small clump on the tread)
views: from the drive side for the chain and crank
close at the handlebar for the levers
close at a wheel for the valve and brake
notes: Frame tubes are hoses between joint points; wheels are groups at the axles. Keep the bike standing upright without a stand.
